name: Decadant Stay
source:
It's rare to be given the chance to change your life with everything you need for it, rarer still for that change to be exactly what you need and desire. This is your getaway, your test to see if you can live the life you yearned for. Although, the challenge itself isn't really hard... because this journey is all about fun and practically drowning in the love of men you could only dream about! 30 days, multiple options, and different ways to approach each date. How fun will your trip be? How long will you last in this... Decadant Stay?

[From [url=https://serenity-project.itch.io/decadant-stay]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
很少有机会用你所需要的一切来改变你的生活，更难得的是这种改变正是你所需要和渴望的。这是你的度假，你的考验，看看你是否能过上你向往的生活。不过，挑战本身并不难……因为这段旅程充满乐趣，几乎淹没在你只能梦想的男人的爱中！30天，多种选择，以及不同的方式来对待每个日期。你的旅行会有多有趣？你会在这种…颓废住宿中坚持多久？

[来自[url=https://serenity-project.itch.io/decadant-stay]Itch.io[/url]]
